facts.text: Penn State World Campus charges online learners the same tuition rate whether they live in Pennsylvania, across the country, or around the world, with no higher out-of-state rate.

sources.title: HR Degree Programs Online - Penn State World Campus
sources.quote: Your Penn State World Campus tuition is the same whether you live in Pennsylvania, across the country, or around the world — World Campus does not charge a higher out-of-state tuition rate for online learners.
